title: Network proxy
serverMeta: The proxy this server uses for outgoing requests: link previews, webhooks, imports and connected services.
computerMeta: The proxy this computer’s Leafen uses for outgoing connections: the app and its own server.

inForce.autoconfig: Using the system’s automatic configuration script, {{address}}.
inForce.autodiscover: Using the automatic configuration script provided by the network.
inForce.none: Connecting directly; the system specifies no proxy.

unfollowed.autoconfig: The system uses an automatic configuration script (PAC), which this build of Leafen doesn’t read. Set the proxy’s address here if outgoing requests fail.
unfollowed.socks: The system specifies a SOCKS proxy, which Leafen doesn’t use. Set an HTTP proxy’s address here if outgoing requests fail.

help: Hosts reached directly are separated by commas: names (.corp.example for its subdomains), addresses and ranges such as 10.0.0.0/8. This computer’s own addresses are always reached directly. The password is stored encrypted and never shown again.
invalid: Give an http:// or https:// address with its port.
saved: The proxy is saved and in use
managedByApp: This server is the desktop app’s own: its proxy is set in the app’s settings, Server accounts → Network proxy.
readFailed: The network proxy couldn’t be read
saveFailed: The network proxy couldn’t be saved
